purpose: Durable record of one exact external-provider attempt for one DANTE email intent, including provider acceptance identity and explicit uncertain/failure classification.

columns.name: email_attempt_ref
columns.meaning: Stable UUIDv7 identity of the provider attempt.

columns.name: attempt_number
columns.meaning: Monotonic attempt ordinal within the owning intent.

columns.name: provider_code
columns.meaning: Last-mile transport used for this attempt.

columns.name: started_at
columns.meaning: Instant the attempt was durably claimed before provider I/O.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.meaning: Instant the provider result classification was persisted.

columns.name: result_code
columns.meaning: Provider-neutral result classification preserving ambiguity explicitly.

columns.name: provider_message_id
columns.meaning: Provider-issued message identity when explicit acceptance returned one.

columns.name: error_code
columns.meaning: Privacy-safe bounded provider or transport error classification.

foreign_keys.name: fk_email_delivery_attempt_intent
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Every provider attempt belongs to exactly one durable DANTE email intent.

unique_constraints.name: uq_email_delivery_attempt_intent_number
unique_constraints.reason: Prevent duplicate attempt ordinals for one intent.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_attempt_uuidv7
check_constraints.reason: Require stable UUIDv7 row identity without using it as chronology authority.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_attempt_provider_code
check_constraints.reason: Bound attempts to reviewed last-mile transports.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_attempt_result_code
check_constraints.reason: Preserve the reviewed provider-neutral result model including uncertainty.

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_attempt_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(started_at) AND (finished_at IS NULL OR (isfinite(finished_at) AND finished_at >= started_at))

check_constraints.name: ck_email_delivery_attempt_result_completion
check_constraints.expression_contract: (result_code='in_progress' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (result_code<>'in_progress' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL)
check_constraints.reason: Bind completion timestamp to terminal provider result classification.

indexes.name: uq_email_delivery_attempt_intent_number
indexes.reason: Database uniqueness arbiter for attempt ordinals.

indexes.name: ix_email_delivery_attempt_intent_ref
indexes.reason: Intent attempt-history lookup and FK support.

indexes.name: uq_email_delivery_attempt_provider_message
indexes.reason: Unique provider-message correlation when explicit acceptance returns an identity.

state_history.current_binding: One immutable attempt identity with a bounded transition from in_progress to exactly one provider-neutral result classification.
state_history.chronology: started_at/finished_at preserve attempt chronology independently of UUID ordering.
state_history.immutability_policy: Intent binding, attempt ordinal, provider and start instant are immutable; only reviewed result columns may change.

lifecycle.retention: Retained as bounded operational evidence for the associated security email lifecycle.
lifecycle.redaction: No message body, OTP, recovery secret or provider raw payload is stored in this table.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; attempts remain evidence attached to the durable intent.

obligations: Real PostgreSQL provider-attempt uniqueness, result classification and least-privilege lifecycle mutation proof.
